title: WOZ + GABEN + THE ORANGE BOX — hyper-localized input, computational history as backscatter

the_bug.what: Pressing H while trying to type popped to a different page
the_bug.why: Global keyboard listener captured ALL keystrokes — no focus check
the_bug.root_cause: Violated the Woz Principle: the keyboard belongs to WHERE YOU ARE TYPING
the_bug.fix: isTyping() guard on ALL global keydown listeners. If focus is in input/textarea/contenteditable, keys stay LOCAL.
the_bug.lesson: This is what Apple solved in 1984. Focus management. Input routing. Hyper-localization.

computational_archaeology.thesis: Every input problem we hit has been solved before. We don't invent — we TRACE. We use these builders as backscatter to find the solutions they already discovered.

D13_WOZ.name: Steve Wozniak
D13_WOZ.archetype: THE HANDS — the engineer who builds what the visionary imagines
D13_WOZ.contribution: Apple I, Apple II — the first PERSONAL computer. Made computing HYPER-LOCAL. Before Woz, a computer was a room. After Woz, it was a desk. Then a lap. Then a pocket.
D13_WOZ.lesson_for_gaia: Hyper-localization. The computer comes TO YOU. The input belongs to YOUR hands. Focus management = knowing WHERE the user IS.
D13_WOZ.diamond: THE PERSONAL IS THE UNIVERSAL — making it small made it big

D14_GABEN.name: Gabe Newell (GabeN)
D14_GABEN.archetype: THE VALVE — the one who controls FLOW of energy in and out
D14_GABEN.contribution: Steam platform, Half-Life, Portal, The Orange Box, Steam Deck
D14_GABEN.lesson_for_gaia: Made PRIVATE games possible on a PUBLIC platform. The valve lets energy in AND out. Steam = water = vapor = the phase transition between liquid and gas. Gabe understood that DISTRIBUTION is the game, not the game itself.
D14_GABEN.diamond: THE PLATFORM IS THE GAME — the store IS the ecosystem
D14_GABEN.valve: A valve controls flow. The Aurora Borealis is the valve at the top of the magnetosphere — solar energy flowing IN. Gabe's Valve = the gate where creator energy flows into player experience.

THE_ORANGE_BOX.name: The Orange Box (2007)
THE_ORANGE_BOX.what: Half-Life 2, Episode One, Episode Two, Portal, Team Fortress 2 — all in one box
THE_ORANGE_BOX.archetype: THE ORIGIN POINT — orange = sunshine = warmth = the first light
meaning: Orange = the color of sunrise. The first thing you see.
Box = container = the thing that holds all the games
It proved BUNDLING creates more value than selling pieces
Portal: 'The cake is a lie' = the reward is the JOURNEY not the destination
TF2: FREE-TO-PLAY proved generosity > greed (TFT forgive one!)
Half-Life: The story that NEVER ENDS (no HL3) = negentropy = maintaining
THE_ORANGE_BOX.connection: The Orange Box IS our origin point. We've been using Steam. The valve is the Aurora Borealis top point. Energy IN (solar wind = data feeds) and OUT (games = creations = primals).

backscatter_traces.pattern: Each builder made something MORE personal, MORE local, MORE accessible. The trajectory is ALWAYS toward hyper-localization. Mainframe → minicomputer → PC → laptop → phone → wearable → organism.

hyper_localization_principle.definition: Every input, every action, every keystroke belongs to WHERE YOU ARE. Not where the system thinks you should be. Not where the global handler wants you. WHERE. YOU. ARE.
implementation: 1. isTyping() guard on ALL global key handlers
2. Focus tracking — know which element has focus at ALL times
3. Context-sensitive shortcuts — same key does different things in different zones
4. Acceleration sense — detect SPEED of input, not just content
5. The keyboard is the human's HAND. Don't steal the hand.
evolutionary_path: Apple 1984: Window focus (which window owns the keyboard?)
Quake 1996: Console toggle (~ opens command, ESC closes — context switch)
Steam 2003: Overlay (Shift+Tab — layer on top without stealing focus)
Valve 2015: Big Picture — full controller input routing per-context
Gaia 2026: Hyper-local — isTyping() + zone awareness + acceleration sense
